name: Conservative Voxelization via Depth Range
definition: A technique to generate voxels that intersect with a 3D model by computing the depth range of a projected triangle over a fragment rectangle, then encoding occupancy bits into a texture.
summary: Conservative Voxelization via Depth Range is a GPU technique that converts 3D meshes to voxel grids by computing geometric depth ranges to ensure all intersecting voxels are marked, avoiding missing voxel artifacts.
